acceptance_condition: All expected outputs are written to the exact mapped paths
The gate decision is evidence-backed and usable by the Orchestrator
The run can be resumed cleanly from the emitted checkpoint if needed
stop_condition: Stop after the baseline inventory, plan, gate decision, manifest, and checkpoint are emitted
Stop early with a checkpoint if blocked or budget-limited
top_risks: First run has not been executed
Lane inference may need adjustment after inventory
